THE SIGN LESSON: both dust pools OVERPRICE the memecoin, so the sign of the fictional delta is set purely by trade DIRECTION — selling the overpriced token (0x7e21b6dc) reads as a catastrophic loss, buying it reads as a windfall. Any screen of the form 'allInCostBps > N' therefore misses half this population; it must be |allInCostBps|.
